title: Read an array item
summary: Bash: Read an array item. Read index 0. Try a small example and check what happens.
introduction: A Bash array keeps indexed values. Its first position is zero.
learningObjectives: Read an array item with Bash

blocks.text: Use a terminal with Bash. Save each example as lesson.sh and run bash lesson.sh. These practice scripts do not delete or change files.
The array has cat at zero and dog at one. Braces select the second value.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Braces are needed around an indexed variable expansion.
